requirement_groups.source_instruction: Students must complete 45 elective History units ( typically 5 courses ) for the History major. Any History Department courses not fulfilling another major requirement may be chosen as an elective. History majors have considerable flexibility in choosing their elective courses, but should consult with the Academic Advisor, Beth Jameson, History Department, Baker Hall 240A, in making their selections. For a complete list of elective course options in History, please consult the History course descriptions elsewhere in this catalog. The selections below are designed to give you a sense of the great variety of thematically centered courses (in addition to the survey courses listed earlier) that History Faculty members regularly teach:
